question_text: Lito is a city planning officer whose cousin owns a construction company that frequently bids on city infrastructure projects. Lito is not directly involved in the bidding process, but he has access to confidential project cost estimates. Which of the following best describes a conflict of interest in this situation?

options.text: Lito has a conflict of interest only if he personally benefits from his cousin's bids.
Lito has a conflict of interest because his official duties and private interests may clash, even without direct involvement.
Lito has no conflict of interest because he is not part of the bidding committee.
Lito has a conflict of interest only if his cousin's company wins a contract.
